lines.scene: She crosses the yard.
I lose the count.
Princess. Don't look so pleased.
I am pleased. That's the problem.
They told me to grow up first.
I grew toward you instead.
You pat my head like a boy.

lines.text: 니가 뭘 알겠냐고 크면 알게 된다고
lines.scene: I am not here to be your boy.
Call it too early. Call it wrong.
I wanted you from the first morning.
Not the crown. The walk.
The way you pretend not to see me

lines.text: 누난 내 여자니까 너는 내 여자니까
lines.scene: and then see nothing else.
My princess.
I will say it until the yard blushes.
If you scold me, I'll take the scold.
If you laugh, I'll take that harder.
Don't save me from this.
I know the rank. I know the years.
I also know your mouth almost smiled.
Come here. Not a bow.
A man, even a young one,

lines.text: 누가 누나를 울린다면 그 누가 됐건간에
lines.scene: can tell when a princess is lonely
in a way rank can't fix.

lines.text: 누난 내 여자니까 너는 내 여자니까
lines.scene: I won't be noble about it.
I'll be here.
When you pass, the numbers fall out of me.
Good. Let them fall.
You are not a lesson.
You are the reason the lesson stops.
My princess. Mine in the only way
that doesn't need a decree.
Stay in the yard one breath longer.
I already lost the count.
I'll lose it again tomorrow.
On purpose.

lines.text: 널 바라만 봐도 난 눈물이 흘러
lines.scene: And she's still the one.
Princess.
Mine.
Still.
